record.question: On which date US President Donald Trump has officially recognized Jerusalem as the capital of Israel?
record.explanation: Answer B: 6th December 2017. Donald Trump’s US presidential proclamation recognizing Jerusalem as Israel’s capital was dated 6 December 2017. This identifies the announcement date, not the later embassy move or universal international recognition. Historical/source note: Historical attribution of a US foreign-policy decision, not a claim of universal international recognition. Reference: https://trumpwhitehouse.archives.gov/presidential-actions/presidential-proclamation-recognizing-jerusalem-capital-state-israel-relocating-united-states-embassy-israel-jerusalem/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
